Method of Attack: Fake decryptor for STOP Djvu ransomware that instead of decrypting files, installs another ransomware called Zorab which double-encrypts already encrypted data
Zorab ransomware encrypts files appending .ZRB extension and creates ransom notes with payment instructions
Impacted Systems: Home users infected through adware bundles pretending to be software cracks
Attack Vector: Fake STOP Djvu decryptor distributed to desperate victims
Adware bundles pretending to be software cracks
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note text containing email zorab28@protonmail.com
